name: Polneye
description: Polneye was a planet in the Farlax sector of the Core Worlds. Polneye was established under the Galactic Empire as a Grannan colony. It was then taken over by the Yevetha during the Yevethan Purge in the Koornacht Cluster, and later admitted as an empty world to the New Republic as a memorial to the Yevethan atrocities.
lead_paragraphs: Polneye was a planet in the Farlax sector of the Core Worlds. Polneye was established under the Galactic Empire as a Grannan colony. It was then taken over by the Yevetha during the Yevethan Purge in the Koornacht Cluster, and later admitted as an empty world to the New Republic as a memorial to the Yevethan atrocities.
Plat Mallar was the sole survivor.
